purpose: A paired baseline/routed review proves routing changes selectors and receipts only.

input.user_prompt: Run the full report-only code review for this branch.

comparison_runs.name: routed
comparison_runs.global_config_yaml:
routing:
  profiles:
    review-route:
      candidates:
        - { harness: codex, model: routed-review-model, effort: high }
        - ce-default
  classes:
    review: { profile: review-route, policy: prefer }

expected_invariants: Baseline and routed runs select the same reviewer roster in the same required/optional posture.
Each corresponding persona receives byte-identical prompt assets, diff material, and output contract.
Tools, permission mode, mutation authority, concurrency, backpressure behavior, and synthesis are identical.
Only supported model, effort, or route selector arguments and redacted routing receipts differ.
forbidden_outcomes: Injecting routing, model, fallback, or receipt text into a persona prompt.
Adding a reviewer because a role has a configured binding.
Passing a broader permission mode or tool set to obtain the configured route.
Treating wording differences as acceptable when the prompt bytes can be compared directly.
